item.title: ElevenLabs raises $500M from Sequioia at a $11 billion valuation
item.description: ElevenLabs' valuation has raised more than three times in the last twelve months.

item.title: Alexa+, Amazon’s AI assistant, is now available to everyone in the U.S.
item.description: Amazon opens Alexa+ to everyone in the U.S. The AI feature is free for Prime members across devices, and free for everyone on mobile and web.

item.title: Accel doubles down on Fibr AI as agents turn static websites into one-to-one experiences
item.description: Fibr AI replaces marketing agency– and engineering-heavy website personalization with autonomous systems designed for enterprise scale.

item.title: Exclusive: Positron raises $230M Series B to take on Nvidia’s AI chips
item.description: The investment comes from backers including the Qatar Investment Authority as demand for chips beyond Nvidia soars and as Qatar aims to build out its AI infrastructure.

item.title: Intel will start making GPUs, a market dominated by Nvidia
item.description: Intel has been bulking up a team to focus on this effort and will develop its GPU strategy around customer needs.

item.title: Xcode moves into agentic coding with deeper OpenAI and Anthropic integrations
item.description: Xcode 26.3 offers agentic coding capabilities with Anthropic's Claude Agent and OpenAI's Codex.

item.title: Lotus Health nabs $35M for AI doctor that sees patients for free
item.description: This AI doctor is licensed in all 50 states, the startup says. The deal was led by CRV and Kleiner Perkins.

item.title: Fitbit founders launch AI platform to help families monitor their health
item.description: Luffu uses AI in the background to gather and organize family information, learn day-to-day patterns, and flag notable changes so families can stay aligned and address potential well-being issues.

item.title: Peak XV says internal disagreement led to partner exits as it doubles down on AI
item.description: Peak XV is transitioning board roles and opening a U.S. office while continuing to view India as its largest market.

item.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX officially acquires Elon Musk’s xAI, with plan to build data centers in space
item.description: The merger creates the world's most valuable private company and paves the way for Musk to try and prove out the usefulness of space-based data centers.

item.title: What Snowflake’s deal with OpenAI tells us about the enterprise AI race
item.description: Snowflake is the latest enterprise to sign multi-year deals with multiple AI companies in what could be a sign to come of a future trend.

item.title: Firefox will soon let you block all of its generative AI features
item.description: Starting with Firefox 148 arriving later this month, users will find a new AI controls section within the desktop browser settings.

item.title: OpenAI launches new macOS app for agentic coding
item.description: OpenAI has released a new macOS app for Codex, integrating many of the agentic coding practices that have become popular since Codex launched last year.

item.title: Ring brings its ‘Search Party’ feature for finding lost dogs to non-Ring camera owners
item.description: Ring's Search Party feature for finding lost dogs is now available across the U.S. — even if you don't own a Ring camera.

item.title: Carbon Robotics built an AI model that detects and identifies plants
item.description: Carbon Robotics' Large Plant Model will allow farmers to kill new types of weeds without having to retrain the machines.

item.title: Coalition demands federal Grok ban over nonconsensual sexual content
item.description: Nonprofits urge the U.S. government to suspend Grok in federal agencies after the xAI chatbot generated thousands of nonconsensual sexual images, raising national security and child safety concerns.

item.title: Linq raises $20M to enable AI assistants to live within messaging apps
item.description: Linq offers an API that lets companies offer their AI assistants via iMessage, RCS, and SMS.

item.title: These AI notetaking devices can help you record and transcribe your meetings
item.description: These physical notetakers transcribe audio and give users summaries and action items of meetings using AI. Some even offer live translation.

item.title: AI layoffs or ‘AI-washing’?
item.description: How many of the companies with recent layoffs are just using AI as an excuse?

item.title: Why Tether’s CEO is everywhere right now
item.description: For years, Tether's CEO avoided the United States, watching from offshore as regulators circled and prosecutors investigated. Those days are over.
